display.purpose: The group hero title only — one use in the whole product.

body.purpose: Default UI text — names, picks, chat.

shadows.name: cta-lift
shadows.purpose: The hero's primary CTA buttons and other newly-elevated primary surfaces.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill-shaped primary action (Refresh scores, Share invite).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0B735F; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; border: none; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #085041; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #085041; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost/outline pill for lower-emphasis actions (Back to group).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #0B735F; border: 1px solid #0B735F; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(11,115,95,0.08); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #085041; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The standard flat white panel used for every section (Standings, Power Rankings, Weekly Locks, Recent Activity, Chat).
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; color: #0F172A; }

components.name: Rank Badge
components.description: Dark pill showing a member's Power Rankings position (#N).
components.css: .ds-rank-badge { background: #0F172A; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; border-radius: 999px; padding: 1px 6px; }

components.name: Vibe Chip
components.description: Text-only flavor tag next to a standings row once a member has 3+ decided games.

components.name: Pick Cell — Win
components.description: A decided-win cell in the Weekly Locks grid.
components.css: .ds-cell { border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; line-height: 14px; } .ds-cell-win { background: #DCFCE7; }

components.name: Pick Cell — Loss
components.description: A decided-loss cell in the Weekly Locks grid.
components.css: .ds-cell { border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; line-height: 14px; } .ds-cell-loss { background: #FEE2E2; }

components.name: Hero CTA
components.description: The two big NFL/CFB pick entry-point buttons on the group hero — the one button style that gets a shadow.
components.css: .ds-hero-cta { background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 20px; padding: 18px 16px; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); border: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-hero-cta:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-hero-cta-title { font-weight: 800; font-size: 17px; color: #0F172A; } .ds-hero-cta-sub { font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; color: #64748B; }

narrative.overview: WeekendLocks is a bulletin board, not a dashboard. Every screen leans on heavy type (700/800 weight is the floor, not the ceiling), pill-shaped chips and buttons, and a deterministic per-person/per-group color-identity system so the same name always wears the same color. Two color systems currently coexist: the product surfaces members use every week run on a plain Turf Teal + slate neutrals + white card system, while a richer Felt Green + Brass Gold palette already exists in lib/theme.ts but is confined to the auth/account shell — a natural candidate to pull forward into the main product.
keyCharacteristics: Bold by default: no regular-weight text anywhere in the product.
Pill everything interactive (999px radius); cards use a consistent 12px radius.
One deterministic hash-color system powers both member avatars and each group's hero background.
Emoji-forward section headers reinforce the 'Locks' brand and competitive personality.
Currently flat with borders instead of shadows, but opening up elevation is the confirmed direction.

rules.name: The Same Hash, Different Canvas Rule
rules.body: Six pastel-background/deep-foreground color pairs are assigned by hashing a user's or group's ID. The same math produces a member's avatar chip and a group's hero background. Never hand-pick an identity color or add a seventh.

rules.name: The No-Regular-Weight Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the product renders below font-weight 700. To de-emphasize, use a lighter color, not a lighter weight.

rules.name: The Pill-or-Twelve Rule
rules.body: Interactive chips/badges/buttons are pill-shaped (999px); structural containers use 12px. Nothing uses a small 4-6px radius for a primary surface.

dos: Do import brand color from lib/theme.ts (colors.brand) rather than hardcoding #0B735F.
Do keep every avatar/identity color flowing through lib/avatar.ts's hash function.
Do keep text at 700 weight or heavier everywhere; use color to de-emphasize.
Do treat Power Rankings and the Weekly Locks grid as the two surfaces worth the most craft.
donts: Don't introduce a second display font.
Don't use opacity to indicate a disabled state on a solid surface.
Don't add a seventh identity color or reorder the existing six.
Don't let the felt/brass palette and the teal/slate palette drift further apart without a decision.
